description.value: Blind Bay Village Grocer is a community-focused full-service grocery store serving the Shuswap region, stocking fresh local meat, produce, bakery and deli goods alongside a broad selection of beer, wine, and spirits. The Blind Bay location also includes an on-site Shell fuel station (bronze, silver, premium, diesel, and marked premium) and a Canada Post outlet, making it a genuine one-stop stop on a touring route. A sister store in nearby Sorrento offers additional coverage for cyclists moving through the corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active, full-service grocery store in Blind Bay with fresh produce, meat, bakery, deli, and a large beer/wine/spirits selection. The navigation includes a 'Weekly Hot Dinners' section, confirming hot prepared food is available. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or other cyclist-specific amenities on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM name is 'Blind Bay Village Grocer' but the brand name on the website is 'Village Grocer' (two-location chain). The Blind Bay store is clearly identified on the site so the listing is valid, but the name differs slightly from the website branding.
Address in OSM is 'Balmoral Road' only — no civic number or postal code. Full address could not be confirmed from the fetched website content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, operational community grocery store with an active website and Shell fuel station on-site — highly useful to touring cyclists passing through the Shuswap.

Hot food.detail: 'Weekly Hot Dinners' is listed as a dedicated section under Flyers & Specials on the website navigation

wow_evidence: A sister store in nearby Sorrento offers additional coverage
